labs.pi_title: Professor of International Politics and founding Director
labs.research_summary: Fletcher School center, set up in 2017, doing policy research on strategy, international politics and US foreign policy, with a focus on alternatives to military intervention.
labs.notes: CSS Team page lists one assistant director (Mathew Yeo) besides the director, then visiting research fellows, visiting scholars and PhD research fellows; no clear core roster, so no count. The 'Our Team' page (page_id=1599) is the Afghanistan Assumptions Project team: principal investigators Michael A. Cohen, Christopher Preble and Toft, a research coordinator (Jefferson Ren) and three research assistants (Cassandra Cronin, Ariel Daniels, Megan Madeira). A former assistant director, Scott D. McDonald, is noted as leaving in August 2025. No email shown for Toft or a general inbox.

notes: The 'Get Involved' link on the start page is the WordPress network admin address and was blocked by robots.txt; no careers or join page was found on the site.
